_doc: Curriculum words that are inflected English forms, and the citation form
a dictionary keys on. Same fault as the predicate heads, one layer down:
these are ordinary lexicon words, and every one of them had a translation
in nought languages while its lemma had between thirty and two hundred
Deliberately conservative. A word that functions as a SYMBOL is not here,
however English it looks -- `min` and `max` name functions the lessons
define, `obj` and `inst` are identifiers, and translating any of them
would destroy the episode that turns on them. Nonce forms and proper
names are absent for the same reason.
`disc` is the odd one out: not inflected, just spelled the way this
curriculum spells it. The dictionaries key on `disk`, so a shape sat
untranslated in every language beside `cube` and `cone`, which did not.
